goal: Small but natural on-device multilingual assistant

stages.purpose: Keep tokenizer coverage and base corpus quality stable before any dialogue tuning.
Teach question understanding, direct answering, short dialogue, and follow-up correction with supervised finetuning.
Add answer planning and reasoning-style examples without exposing hidden chain-of-thought in user-facing output.
Promote checkpoints only when the fixed public regression prompt set improves.

promotion_policy.rule: Only promote a new checkpoint when pass rate improves on the fixed regression set and no major category regresses.

runtime_guidance.notes: For the current 1.3 browser model, lower-temperature direct answers are more stable than creative high-temperature sampling.
